## Universal Props Reference Layout — Text Mirror of the Visual Sheet

This is the **written/visual template** of the props and set dressing sheet (Gilgamesh Palace style). Use it as a layout guide when generating any props reference image, or as a structural guide when describing the layout. Generic placeholders only — fill with any project's content.

## VISUAL DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

**Background**: Warm dark charcoal (#1A0F08) OR cream (#F4ECDD) depending on location mood. Dark background suits palace/ancient/luxury; cream suits modern/clean/museum-catalog.

**Typography**:
- Header in elegant serif uppercase
- Section labels in tiny serif caps
- Prop labels in tiny serif caps below each item

**Header (top strip, 3-column)**:
- LEFT: "SET DRESSING SHEET" in small caps serif
- CENTER: Large elegant serif uppercase "[LOCATION NAME] DECOR & PROPS"
- RIGHT: Project title (small serif), optional scene info below

**Row 1** — 4 equal mood cells of the dressed location:
1. INTERIOR MOOD — full wide of the fully dressed space
2. ARCHITECTURAL DETAIL — close on a relief, column, carving, or signature architectural feature
3. CEREMONIAL OBJECTS — still life of key ritual or signature props grouped together
4. TEXTILES & FURNISHINGS — cushions, drapes, rugs, soft furnishings detail

Labels in tiny serif caps below each cell.

**Row 2 LEFT (~40% width)** — Large hero interior shot:
- Dressed space with all key props in place
- Cinematic mood lighting (practicals visible)
- Reveals the spatial relationship of furniture and decor

**Row 2 RIGHT (~60% width)** — PROP DETAILS grid (6 columns x 3 rows = 18 isolated cells):
- Each prop isolated on neutral background with subtle drop shadow
- Captioned in tiny serif caps below each item
- Section header "PROP DETAILS" at top in elegant serif caps

**Bottom strip (full width)** — Color + Material palette:
- 10-11 swatches mixing solid colors and material textures
- Captioned in tiny serif caps below each swatch
- Examples: aged bronze, hammered gold, dark clay, cedar brown, reed tan, linen ivory, lapis blue, carnelian red, smoke black, torch amber

## REQUIRED PROPS / SET DRESSING FIELDS

When filling this template, define and lock the following:

- **LOCATION NAME**: [where these props belong]
- **ERA / SETTING**: [date or fictional era]
- **MOOD / EMOTIONAL TONE**: [what feeling this dressed space produces]
- **KEY ARCHITECTURAL FEATURE**: [signature element — relief, column, fireplace, screen]
- **CEREMONIAL OBJECTS** (5-7 hero props): [list with materials, sizes, significance]
- **TEXTILES & FURNISHINGS**: [cushions, rugs, drapes, banners — materials and patterns]
- **PROP LIST (18 items for the grid)**: [each with material, color, function]
- **COLOR & MATERIAL PALETTE (10-11 swatches)**: [hex codes plus texture descriptors]
- **CHEKHOV OBJECTS** (story-significant props): [which props will be used in the plot]
- **LIGHTING ON PROPS**: [direction, color, intensity]

---

## RULES FOR USING THIS TEMPLATE

1. Use box-drawing characters for the ASCII layout.
2. Keep all 4 mood cells equal width with consistent lighting.
3. Hero shot occupies ~40% of the second row; PROP DETAILS grid occupies ~60%.
4. PROP DETAILS grid is exactly 6 columns x 3 rows = 18 cells.
5. Each prop isolated on neutral background — no overlapping items.
6. Materials palette strip spans full width at the bottom with 10-11 swatches.
7. Background can be warm dark (palace/ancient/luxury) or cream (museum/clean/modern). The label typography follows the piece's register: the serif lettering above is the default, and a children's piece takes a rounded sans.
8. Same lighting style across all 4 mood cells and all 18 prop cells.
9. Group thematically — ceremonial together, textiles together, weapons together.

## END OF PROPS / SET DRESSING SHEET TEXT-VISUAL TEMPLATE

This template is generic and reusable for any location's props and set dressing — historical, modern, fantasy, sci-fi, palace, hovel, workshop, ship. Fill placeholders with the project's content while keeping the visual structure identical.
